'''''Coreopsis grandiflora''''' is a [[North America]]n [[species]] of [[perennial plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]].  The common name is '''large-flowered tickseed'''.<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> It is found in eastern [[Canada]] ([[Quebec]], [[Ontario]], [[New Brunswick]]) and much of the [[United States]], especially the south-central part of the country ([[Oklahoma]], [[Arkansas]], etc.).<ref>[http://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Coreopsis%20grandiflora.png Biota of North America Program 2014 county distribution map]</ref> The species is widely cultivated in [[China]] and naturalized there.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=200023716 Flora of China, <big>大花金鸡菊</big> da hua jin ji ju ''Coreopsis grandiflora'' Hogg ex Sweet]</ref>

''Coreopsis grandiflora'' is a [[Perennial plant|perennial]] herb<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center - The University of Texas at Austin|url=https://www.wildflower.org/plants/result.php?id_plant=cogr5|access-date=2022-01-12|website=www.wildflower.org}}</ref> sometimes greater than 60 cm (2 feet) tall. It produces yellow ray and disc flowers.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=200023716 Flora of North America, ''Coreopsis grandiflora'' Hogg ex Sweet, Brit. Fl. Gard. 2: plate 175. 1826. ]</ref> Its native habitats include prairies, glades, open woods, thickets, roadsides and open ground. The Latin specific epithet ''grandiflora'' means large-flowered.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Coreopsis grandiflora - Plant Finder|url=https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/PlantFinder/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=277711|access-date=2022-01-12|website=www.missouribotanicalgarden.org}}</ref> The plant attracts bees and butterflies.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Coreopsis grandiflora (Common Coreopsis, Large Flower Tickseed, Largeflower Tickseed, Tickseed) {{!}} North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox|url=https://plants.ces.ncsu.edu/plants/coreopsis-grandiflora/|access-date=2022-01-12|website=plants.ces.ncsu.edu}}</ref>

In the UK the [[cultivar]] 'Early Sunrise'<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/81224/Coreopsis-grandiflora-Early-Sunrise/Details | title = ''Coreopsis grandiflora'' 'Early Sunrise' | publisher = RHS | accessdate = 12 April 2020}}</ref> has received the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].
